These files were copied from aap-config-chart (test_sscsi) after local edits for csiWorkloadIdentity.

Apply them to your fork (e.g. github.com/mhjacks/aap-config-chart), bump Chart.yaml version, commit, and
point values-hub.yaml chartVersion at the new release. Then run: helm dependency update

Unified values:
  csiWorkloadIdentity.enabled + serviceAccount + namespace + vaultAuthMount + appKey
  optional vaultKubernetesAuthRole (full Vault role name for Ansible hash mode)
  optional vaultSkipTLSVerify (string "true"/"false")

Pattern override: overrides/values-aap-config-csi.yaml

Ansible: set ssCsiWorkloadAuth[].roleSlug to the stable segment (ns-sa-appKey) when using empty
vaultKubernetesAuthRole, or set vaultKubernetesAuthRole in Helm and matching roleSlug in Ansible.
